full_details: You carried the book out by Moorgate. At St John's the office was full of tilt-staves and painted paper for Monday. Tilney read an hour and a quarter with the pen in his hand, and the pen did not come down until he signed. He found a prince who is obeyed, a friar who means well, and two children who die of not minding their elders. He found nothing that touches the state or any person living. When you asked, he offered to find something if you were lonely for it. He signed the last leaf. He said your other play keeps within its bounds in Shoreditch, and to let it. Heminges counted out seven shillings. After Tilney had turned to his paper, you said you had been cut twice and never so slighted. Heminges said a clean licence is the only kind he can afford. At the Bell, Gilbert had already been and gone back to St Bride's. The letter of the 26th was already in the bag. Anne's letter was on the stair when you came in. A woman from Bridge Street will do the great wash through the winter at fourpence a week, paid already out of the Michaelmas money. You were told, not asked. You wrote no answer. The company played The Two Gentlemen of Verona without you. The Rose had the second Tamburlaine. You did not go.
one_sentence: You took the book to Tilney, read that the winter wash was already paid, and left Anne's answer for another day.
title: A clean licence, and seven shillings
